continuities.name: Ghostbusters (original continuity)
continuities.description: The 1984 film, Ghostbusters II, the 2009 video game (by the film writers, set two years after II), Afterlife and Frozen Empire.
continuities.quote: The series returned to the original canon with Ghostbusters: Afterlife (2021) and Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire (2024). … It is a sequel to Ghostbusters (1984) and Ghostbusters II (1989) and is the third mainline installment … Set thirty-two years after the events of Ghostbusters II

continuities.name: Ghostbusters (2016 reboot)
continuities.description: Paul Feig's 2016 reboot; Sony abandoned its sequel and continued the original canon instead.
continuities.quote: it is a reboot of the Ghostbusters franchise, as well as serving as its third installment. … Sony abandoned plans for a sequel, opting instead to continue the original film canon with Ghostbusters: Afterlife (2021).

continuities.name: Ghostbusters (animated series)
continuities.description: The Real Ghostbusters (1986–1991) and its sequel Extreme Ghostbusters (1997). Kept separate from the films: the show reworks the film concept and treats the 1984 film as a movie made about the team.
continuities.quote: Although the Ghostbusters concept was tinkered with, the finalized show does feature many tie-ins from the films. In the season 1 episode "Take Two", the Ghostbusters fly to Hollywood to visit the set of a movie based on their adventures, which is revealed to be the 1984 movie at the end of the episode. … A sequel to The Real Ghostbusters, which aired from 1986 to 1991 on ABC, Extreme Ghostbusters is set after that series' finale.
continuities.note: The Real Ghostbusters lead also calls it "a spin-off and sequel of the 1984 comedy film Ghostbusters"; kept as its own continuity per the caller default (the 1984 film exists as an in-universe movie in "Take Two"). Recorded as a spinoff link.
